sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Forge a Friendship is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello, warrior! You asked about the BTR driver, and in theory we could work together. I've already used the services of his BTR, but going against Skier is not cheap. That's why we need to solidify our intentions, so that no one slips up later! First, I need to get a package that came from outside the cordon. I'm told it's already here, somewhere in the Norvinsk port area."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and obtain Prapor's cargo on Shoreline
- Hand over the found cargo

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Kalashnikov AK-12 5.45x39 assault rifle
- 3× AK-74 5.45x39 6L26 45-round magazine
- 2× 5.45x39mm BP gs ammo pack (120 pcs)
"Good work, soldier! I'll be in touch with you about working with the driver."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Cargo for Prapor | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
In this quest you have to find Prapor's cargo on Shoreline. It can be found in the office building at the pier. There are multiple spawns throughout the building.

sections.heading: First spawn
sections.text: In the left side room on the table.

sections.heading: Second spawn
sections.text: On the floor behind the counter.

sections.heading: Third spawn
sections.text: On a wooden crate in the storage room in the right side of the building.

sections.heading: Fourth spawn
sections.text: Behind the wardrobe in the left side of the building.

sections.heading: Fifth spawn
sections.text: Under one of the desks in the right side of the building.
